digest.component_or_area: Agent tooling and code navigation guidance
propositions: Agents prefer grep over Serena symbol tools despite documented guidance because grep requires zero extra steps while Serena incurs a ToolSearch discovery cost.
Serena LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g. monkeypatch.setattr, getattr, importlib), causing it to miss real call sites that grep finds.
Serena's index can lag behind recent edits and returns stale line numbers, while grep searches the current tree.
The rule 'prefer symbol tools over grep' is ineffective because it is a standing disposition loaded once at session start without in-the-moment triggers or feedback when violated.
The two tools fail in opposite directions (LSP misses strings, grep produces false positives in comments) and must be used as a divided labour, not a strict hierarchy.
